name: Toriko no Kizuna ~Ubawareta Gakuen ni Hibiku Shojo no Aegi~
original_name: 虜ノ絆～奪われた学園に響く処女の喘ぎ～
source:
St. Ruri Girls Academy is a private institution recognized for providing the highest quality personnel to the financial, political and sports world, this year it is celebrating its 100th anniversary and so a memorial ceremony is scheduled for the next month.

The Student Council President and second year student, Hinomiya Maika, is the granddaughter of current principal Sakurakouji Rentarou, however she keeps it a secret and only a few people know it. Maika and her friends spent their busy and fulfilling days towards the memorial ceremony until a certain day, a sudden change came to their peaceful school days. The principal, Rentarou, suddenly fell ill, and so, a man named Tendou Motoya came to take the role of acting director. Maika was suspicious of him and when she looked it up, she discovered that Motoya had a grudge against Rentarou and now he had taken over the school to clear said grudge. 

It was then that Maika asked her friends for help to regain the school. Those friends were, her childhood friends Nikaidou Rie and Iori Sara, the former Student Council President Tamaki Juri and the Student Council Advisor Yomogi Youko. Also, those people were the only ones in school that knew about Maika being the granddaughter of the principal. Maika knew that if Motoya knew that she was related to Rentarou it might turn out dangerous, so before it could happen, she secretly started collecting evidence to kick Motoya out of school, because he wasn't appointed officially. But alas, a certain day Maika was discovered to be Rentarou's granddaughter and then, she suffered a relentless torture at the hands of Motoya and his colleagues. Maika decided to hide her situation from her friends and prepare a counterattack without getting them involved.

Then, could it be possible for Maika to regain the school as she receives the harsh torture every day or will she end being swallowed like that?

[From [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/torikonokizuna/]Official Website[/url]]
translation:
私立圣瑠璃女学园以向财经、政界及体育界输送优秀人才而闻名。今年恰逢建校100周年，下个月将举行纪念典礼。

学生会长日之宫舞果是学园二年级学生，也是现任学园长樱小路莲太郎的孙女。不过，她一直隐瞒着这层关系，只有少数人知情。舞果与伙伴们为纪念典礼忙碌着，日子充实而平静，直到某一天，学园生活突然发生了变化。学园长莲太郎突发急病，一名叫天堂元弥的男子前来担任代理学园长。舞果心生怀疑，展开调查后发现，元弥与莲太郎有仇，此番是为了复仇而来夺取学园。

得知真相后，舞果向伙伴们求助，希望夺回学园。这四位伙伴分别是她的青梅竹马二阶堂梨枝、衣织纱来，前任学生会长环珠里，以及学生会顾问蓬生阳子。学园中，知道舞果是学园长孙女的人，也只有她们。舞果明白，一旦元弥得知自己与莲太郎的关系，事情可能会变得危险。因此，她们在身份暴露前秘密搜集证据，想证明元弥并未获得正式任命，将他逐出学园。然而，某一天，舞果还是被发现是莲太郎的孙女，随即遭到元弥及其同伙无休止的折磨。舞果决定向伙伴们隐瞒自己的处境，在不把她们卷入其中的情况下，悄悄准备反击。

面对每天严酷的折磨，舞果究竟能否夺回学园？还是会就此被吞噬？
